text: The setting: a dining room in French Switzerland in the eighteen eighties, with a view of Lake Léman over the cypress trees of a churchyard, so death is in the view from the start. Monsieur Durand keeps a boarding house for tourists, and it is failing: one tourist in two months, since the railway went east instead. Debts are everywhere. But, he tells his eldest daughter Adèle, he has paid the fire insurance. Remember that.
